label: Stock snapshot gap recovery
info: See stock-gap-saving.README.md. Replace old saving branches; connect completed code-wise update results to the matching entry. Single-flight queues per stock type.

name: floor: QUEUED ENTRY after code-wise save
func: const key='rx_gap_floor_queue'; const queue=flow.get(key)||[]; queue.push(msg); flow.set(key,queue); if(flow.get('rx_gap_floor_busy')) return null; flow.set('rx_gap_floor_busy',true); return queue.shift();

name: floor: validate completed shift
floor: query entire snapshot gap
floor: Influx shift buckets since last snapshot
floor: calculate chronological closing balances
floor: verify snapshot insert
func: const result=Array.isArray(msg.payload)?msg.payload[0]:msg.payload; if(result?.acknowledged!==true) throw Error('Snapshot insert was not acknowledged'); msg.payload={saved:true,id:msg.stockGapDocument._id,calculationFrom:msg.stockGapDocument.calculationFrom,coveredShifts:msg.stockGapDocument.coveredShifts};return msg;

name: floor: release queue
func: const queue=flow.get('rx_gap_floor_queue')||[]; const next=queue.shift(); flow.set('rx_gap_floor_queue',queue); if(!next) flow.set('rx_gap_floor_busy',false); return [msg,next||null];

name: floor: report failure and release queue
